answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn attestations from established, unrelated peers before it can transact at full volume — a trellis of independent vouches that a single operator cannot fake cheaply. Like quartz veins running through rock, genuine history accumulates slowly and is costly to counterfeit: duplicate behavior across identities triggers slashing of every linked bond, so spawning a thousand saffron-trading sock puppets costs a thousand stakes while yielding only one vote each. Attack cost scales linearly; honest reputation compounds.
